name: PBB Salus
shortDescription: Local evacuation-center registration, occupancy, relief-batch receipt, and citizen QR workflows in active development.
longDescription: PBB Salus is an in-progress local evacuation-center and relief-distribution module. Its implemented Laravel foundation covers multiple centers, express and regular registration, validation, opaque tags and QR codes, movement or aggregate occupancy tracking, relief batches, receipts, and correction workflows.

Person-level records remain local. Hotline may pull a bearer-protected, privacy-safe aggregate summary for SITREP use, while release packaging, Kit Setup installation, and full relief inventory remain outside the confirmed V1 implementation.

readiness.note: Operational routes and data models are implemented through the current milestones, but release packaging and field installation are not complete.
remainingWork: Build release metadata, installer, Data Prep, and Kit Setup integration.
Complete privacy, retention, backup, purge, and access-control tests.
Keep full relief inventory deferred unless a reviewed scope change is approved.

problemSolved: Evacuation operations need one local record of active centers, registrations, current occupancy, relief schedules, and receipts even when internet access is unavailable and person-level data must remain within the node.

workflowSteps.title: Activate local centers
workflowSteps.description: Operators open one or more evacuation-center activations and configure capacity, zones, and tracking mode.

workflowSteps.title: Register and validate
workflowSteps.description: Workers use express or regular lanes for individuals and families, then validate records and issue opaque tags or QR codes.

workflowSteps.title: Track occupancy
workflowSteps.description: The operation records individual entry and exit or approved aggregate gate counts, with reconciliation when needed.

workflowSteps.title: Record relief receipt
workflowSteps.description: Workers manage scheduled relief batches, confirm receipts, and route corrections through controlled approval.

workflowSteps.title: Share safe aggregates
workflowSteps.description: Hotline can request aggregate counts and freshness metadata without receiving person-level records.

localCapabilities: Center activation, registration, validation, tags, movement, occupancy, relief receipts, and citizen QR status are local-node workflows.
Printer, scanner, and camera failures have documented local fallback paths, subject to validation requirements.
requiresLocalServices: Salus requires its Laravel application, local database, protected storage, and configured local HTTPS.
Account supports new sign-in; Realtime provides optional change notices but the database and REST API remain authoritative.
syncsWhenConnected: Account can support sign-in and app-admin provisioning when reachable.
Realtime can publish privacy-safe change notifications, and Hotline can pull an aggregate summary over the node network.
connectivityRequired: New Account SSO sessions wait for the local Account service when it is unavailable.
No internet route is required for the core center workflow after a complete local installation.
notSynchronized: Person-level evacuee, photo, movement, and relief-receipt records are not synchronized across nodes in V1.
Direct Relay, Support, MapServer, Maestro, and full inventory integrations are not confirmed for V1.

screenshots.title: Validated Salus interface pending
screenshots.caption: The runtime is in active development and no public interface image has been approved for this page.

faqs.question: Can Salus operate without internet access?
faqs.answer: Yes. Core evacuation-center work can continue on the local PBB network as long as the Salus node and its database are running.

faqs.question: Are evacuee records sent to Hotline?
faqs.answer: No individual evacuee records are sent under the confirmed design. Hotline receives only approved totals and basic information showing how recent and complete those totals are.

faqs.question: Does Salus manage a complete relief warehouse inventory?
faqs.answer: No. V1 records planned relief batches, what people receive, and corrections. Full warehouse work such as receiving stock, storage, transfers, damaged or lost goods, purchasing, and accounting is not included yet.

faqs.question: What information is stored in the citizen QR code?
faqs.answer: The QR code contains a random, hard-to-guess identifier instead of personal information. Scanning it provides only a limited local view.

faqs.question: Is Salus ready for field installation?
faqs.answer: Not yet. Much of the application is built, but its release package, installer, data-preparation tools, and connection to Kit Setup are still incomplete.

faqs.question: Does Salus include geofencing or map tracking?
faqs.answer: No. V1 does not include map display, location-based boundaries, a native mobile app, or continuous tracking of people's locations.
